Hydrophobic_Diving_Bell_Hairs.description: The Water Spider's Hydrophobic Diving Bell Hairs are a unique evolutionary trait, allowing the arachnid to weave together a silken bubble that repels water, enabling it to breathe and move with astonishing speed and agility underwater, where its fin-like appendages slice through the currents with ease.

Oar_Like_Swimming_Pedipalps.description: Equipped with elongated, oar-like pedipalps, this arachnid's unique appendages slice through water with unmatched grace and speed, granting an aquatic agility and the ability to perform a swift Swim Dash maneuver.

Flattened_Ambulatory_Paddles.description: These flattened ambulatory paddles, a bizarre mutation seen only in the most ancient arachnid predators of the swamps, serve both as efficient swimming fins and sturdy walking appendages, enhancing the creature's strength and agility on all terrains.

Acoustic_Lateral_Line_Fringes.description: Bristling with delicate, hair-like filaments along the edges of their segmented limbs, these arachnids possess an Acoustic Lateral Line Fringes component that enhances their aquatic navigation and perception, allowing them to detect the slightest vibrations and currents in the water, effectively granting them blindsight.

Deeper_Caudal_Locomotion_Ridge.description: This sinuous, scorpion-like entity boasts a formidable caudal ridge that extends into a series of sharp, segmented fins, enhancing its swimming speed through the dark, murky waters but at the cost of its agility and maneuverability in tight spaces.

Serrated_Defensive_Dorsal_Sail.description: The arachnid's dorsal sail, a web of interconnected spines and fins, not only enhances its swimming efficiency but also serves as a formidable defensive mechanism, increasing its natural armor and charisma, while granting the ability to block attacks with a mere flick of its serrated sail.

Web_Anchoring_Benthic_Tarsi.description: Equipped with powerful anchoring tarsi and sleek, hydrodynamic fins, this component allows the arachnid to firmly grasp the ocean floor while swimming, enhancing its strength and granting resilience against being swept away by currents or knocked back in combat.

Vestigial_Sclerotized_Nods.description: Tiny, hardened nodules line the edges of this arachnid’s carapace, remnants of ancient fins adapted for traversing sandy dunes, now vestigial and offering a subtle boost to mental fortitude at the cost of agility.

Bioluminescent_Lure_Fringes.description: Glowing fringes of intricate bioluminescent patterns extend from the arachnid's sleek, hydrodynamic fins, casting an ethereal light that serves both to mesmerize potential prey and to navigate the dark depths of the ocean, though the radiant allure comes at the cost of increased visibility to predators.

Adhesive_Rheophilic_Pads.description: Equipped with chitinous rheophilic pads, these specialized fins enable the creature to navigate the turbulent currents of rivers and streams with ease, while secreting an adhesive substance that allows for effortless climbing on vertical surfaces, even under water.
